tips: A lane counter against your direct opponent matters more than a champion's overall win rate.
Don't stack one damage type: mix physical and magic, or one enemy item shuts down half your team.
Your team needs a frontline — someone has to start fights and absorb damage.
Pick comfort: a champion you know is usually stronger than an unfamiliar counter.
Against poke you need engage and mobility; against dive — peel and cc for your carry.
Last pick is an advantage: tailor it to the enemy comp already revealed.
Bans remove either the strongest in the patch or whatever is hardest for you.
Synergy wins teamfights: lockdown+burst catch a target, engage+peel keep the carry alive.
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Tell us via Support on the site — counterplays.com/support.

airborne.name: Ult combo: knock-up → Yasuo/Yone
airborne.desc: A knock-up activates Yasuo/Yone's ultimate on the whole grouped team.
airborne.tipAlly: Engage with a knock-up — Yasuo/Yone ult in right after. Hit them while grouped.
airborne.tipEnemy: Don't group up or get caught by a knock-up — it's their wombo-combo trigger. Keep spread and cleanse (Mercurial, QSS).

orianna.name: Ball lightning (Orianna + engage)
orianna.desc: Ball on the engager: they dive, Orianna ults to pull in and blow up the whole group.
orianna.tipAlly: Put the ball on the diving engager and follow up right after their engage.
orianna.tipEnemy: Watch who has Orianna's ball — the engage comes on them. Spread out before they initiate.

immortal.name: Immortality (protective ult + dive)
immortal.desc: An invulnerability/save ult lets the carry dive into the middle without risking death.
immortal.tipAlly: Dive aggressively — save the protective ult for the carry's damage peak.
immortal.tipEnemy: Don't waste your focus while their invulnerability is up — wait it out, then kill the carry.

enchanter.name: Hypercarry buff (enchanter + carry)
enchanter.desc: Attack/move-speed buffs and shields turn an immobile carry into a damage machine.
enchanter.tipAlly: Stick to the carry, buff and peel for them — they're your main damage.
enchanter.tipEnemy: Kill the carry fast or get on their backline: without the enchanter they're helpless. Choke them in lane.

hook.name: Hook pick
hook.desc: A hook rips a target out of position; burst champions finish it before help arrives.
hook.tipAlly: Look for hooks on isolated targets — instantly focus the caught one as a team.
hook.tipEnemy: Don't walk alone and keep distance from hook champions. Respect river vision.

aoe.name: Teamfight ults (double AoE)
aoe.desc: Several strong AoE ults stack and wipe a grouped team at once.
aoe.tipAlly: Start fights in chokepoints when both ults are up — land them on the enemy group.
aoe.tipEnemy: Don't stack up or push into chokepoints when their ults are up. Split and enter one at a time.

burstPick.name: Burst pick (cc → delete)
burstPick.desc: An enemy is caught by cc (charm/stun/root) and instantly deleted by burst before they can react.
burstPick.tipAlly: Hunt isolated targets: one locks them with cc, the rest focus and delete in a second.
burstPick.tipEnemy: Don't walk alone, keep vision and save your dash/QSS for their initiator — they'll unload all burst on whoever's caught.

artillery.name: Artillery (long range)
artillery.desc: Several long-range champions push the lane and objectives from afar without trading.
artillery.tipAlly: Poke the enemy down from range before fights and siege objectives — don't go melee first.
artillery.tipEnemy: Don't sit in the poke: engage fast or flank, take shields/mobility and force close-range fights.

global.name: Global pressure
global.desc: Global ults provide help and picks across the map — strong pressure in split-push.
global.tipAlly: Pressure in split and take cross-map picks with globals — stretch the enemy.
global.tipEnemy: Don't overstay in 4v5 skirmishes — their globals even the numbers. Respect when their champs are off the map.

lovers.name: The Lovers (Xayah + Rakan)
lovers.desc: Xayah and Rakan empower each other: extended engage range, shared recalls and layered CC.
lovers.tipAlly: Play bot as one unit — Rakan engages further with Xayah nearby, and she covers his exit with feathers.
lovers.tipEnemy: Don't trade into both at once: Rakan's engage range is longer than usual. Punish whoever is alone.

kalista.name: Fate's Call (Kalista + engage)
kalista.desc: Kalista's ult throws an engage ally into the enemy team — an unstoppable knock-up initiation from safety.
kalista.tipAlly: Save the ult for the engage partner: launch them into clumped enemies or use it to reset a failed dive.
kalista.tipEnemy: Spread out and track Kalista's ult — the thrown ally lands with a knock-up. Don't group in her sight.

isolate.name: Isolation (Nocturne dive)
isolate.desc: Nocturne's ult blinds the map and dives a target; lockdown or burst confirms the kill before help arrives.
isolate.tipAlly: Ult the target your team can lock down or burst — the pick happens before their team can react.
isolate.tipEnemy: After level 6, don't walk alone: his ult isolates stragglers. Group up and hold vision of him.

arrow.name: Arrow → dive (Ashe setup)
arrow.desc: Ashe's global arrow stuns from across the map — a diver follows up on the frozen target instantly.
arrow.tipAlly: Fire arrows at picks and objectives — your diver converts every hit into a kill.
arrow.tipEnemy: Dodge or body-block the arrow: one hit means their whole follow-up lands on you. Keep a cleanse ready.

trap.name: Trap setup (Caitlyn + CC)
trap.desc: Caitlyn's traps under allied hooks and stuns lock a target in place for free headshots.
trap.tipAlly: Lay traps where your support lands CC — every hook or stun becomes a guaranteed trap and headshot.
trap.tipEnemy: Don't get hooked near her traps — the chain lockdown is lethal. Clear traps around objectives.

splitpush.name: Split-push (1-3-1)
splitpush.desc: A strong side-laner pushes while a global ult covers them — the enemy can't answer both sides.
splitpush.tipAlly: Push side lanes and force them to answer — the global ult punishes any collapse or cross-map fight.
splitpush.tipEnemy: Don't chase the splitter 3-deep — force 5v4 fights elsewhere before their global arrives.

diveball.name: Full dive team
diveball.desc: Three or more divers jump the backline at once — no peel can stop every threat.
diveball.tipAlly: Commit the dive together onto their carries — split entries waste your numbers advantage.
diveball.tipEnemy: Stack peel and disengage, group tightly and keep your carries behind the frontline at all times.

pool.help: Champion pools are your own champion sets per role. When a pool is on, Counterplay always highlights the best pick from it against the current enemies — so you can stay on champions you actually play. Duo pools are for you and a friend: when your partner takes a champion from the pool, you get the picks that pair best with it.
helpSteps: Press + under Pool: name the set and add champions role by role.
Save — the tile shows up in the list. Click its star to turn the pool on.
Switch Normal / Pool / Duo on the ready screen.
For a duo, press + under Duo: it holds two sets, yours and your partner's.
Export in the editor hands the pool over as a file; your friend loads it with the Import a pool tile.
A friend's personal pool dropped on Duo becomes their half — you pick one of your own for the other.

comp.planF2b: Fight five on five around objectives: front line ahead, carries behind.
comp.planDive: Dive their back line together and at once — never go in one by one.
comp.planPoke: Poke before objectives and catch stragglers; avoid long head-on fights.
comp.planEarly: You are strong early — press the lanes and end before 25 minutes.
comp.planLate: You come online late — play safe and farm until your items are in.

comp.enemyPlanF2b: They will fight five on five at objectives behind their front line — don't hit into their tanks, go for their carries.
comp.enemyPlanDive: They will dive your back line all at once — stay together and protect your carries.
comp.enemyPlanPoke: They will poke before objectives and catch stragglers — don't walk alone, close the distance fast.
comp.enemyPlanEarly: They are strong early — survive the first 20 minutes and the game turns your way.
comp.enemyPlanLate: They come online late — press them early and don't drag the game out.
